selection_rule: Four Bazel temporal candidates are frozen before source acquisition outcomes. Each candidate must have four unique Bazel-authored authoritative source files spanning exactly four producer allocations, at least three required human-authored primary or normative sources, an exact same-key cross-time conflicting claim separated by at least 180 days, ordered deterministic answer slots, and no exact source-byte reuse with any previously selected confirmatory case. Treatment/evaluator outcomes may not be observed or used.

candidates.question: Across the pinned Bazel test-option sources, give four values in order: the post-change default of --experimental_cancel_concurrent_tests; the pre-change default; the post-change value that cancels after a failed run; and the post-change value that cancels after a passed run.

Across the pinned Bazel coverage sources, give four values in order: the post-change default behavior for experimental fetch-all coverage outputs; its pre-change default; the post-change default behavior for split coverage postprocessing; and its pre-change default.

candidates.canonical_target_subject: retain test configuration across testonly default transition
candidates.question: Across the pinned Bazel test-trimming sources, give four values in order: the post-change default of --experimental_retain_test_configuration_across_testonly; the pre-change default; the rule attribute for which enabling the flag prevents trimming; and the parent flag whose false value makes the retain option have no effect.
